name: Dragging Palm
description: Drag the palm down an opponent's arm and let each part of it lag behind the part before.

name: Thick Air
description: Slow the time in the air before the chest so that thrown things lose their speed.

name: Slack Grip
description: Slow the closing of a grip by a heartbeat so a held weapon slips away.

name: Long Moment
description: Make one moment long for the user alone so that thought has time to choose.

name: Late Blow
description: Strike with a palm so that the harm lands a breath after the touch.

name: Calm Pace
description: Slow the passing of time in an ally's wound so the bleeding eases.

name: Leaden Time
description: Sink an opponent's whole body into slowed time so that every move comes late.

name: Slowing Ring
description: Ring the user with a short span of slowed time that drags anyone who steps into it.

name: Early Fist
description: Throw a fist whose time runs ahead so it lands before the opponent has seen it start.

name: Quick Parry
description: Hasten the forearm to turn aside a blow that would otherwise arrive first.

name: Fast Read
description: Read an opponent's first twitch and know the blow that follows it.

name: Brisk Mend
description: Hasten the mending of an ally's torn muscle so that it holds within a few breaths.

name: Rapid Chain
description: Chain three quickened strikes as the user steps forward through an opponent's slow reply.

name: Hastened Lance
description: Quicken a thrust so that the point is through the guard before the guard knows.

name: Echo Strike
description: Repeat a strike's last motion a moment later so that a second faint blow lands.

name: Delayed Pellet
description: Throw a pellet whose impact is held back a few heartbeats before it lands.

name: Echo Guard
description: Repeat a guard so that a second ghost of it stands after the first is struck.

name: Trailing Echo
description: Listen to the faint echo of a recent sound and learn where it began.

name: Delay Step
description: Step and leave a trailing echo of the step behind to draw the eye.

name: Repeat Mend
description: Repeat the first moment of a healing touch so the treatment works again a short while after.

name: Double Strike
description: Hit once and echo the hit a heartbeat later on the same spot.

name: Delay Chain
description: Chain three moves and delay the last so that it lands after the guard drops.

name: Echoing Purge
description: Repeat a cleansing touch so the second pass finds the taint that the first one missed.

name: Gap Count
description: Count the gaps between an opponent's blows and learn the rhythm of the fight.

name: Gap Strike
description: Strike into the gap between two of an opponent's blows before the second begins.

name: Span Guard
description: Raise a guard only for the span in which a blow lands and drop it in the gap after.

name: Even Tempo
description: Keep an even tempo in breath and step so that each move costs less qi.

name: Lull Touch
description: Stretch the gap between an opponent's moves with a light touch until the gap becomes a pause.

name: Measured Hold
description: Hold an opponent in one measured span of time so that they cannot step out of it.

name: Tempo Mend
description: Quicken the mending of a wound in even pulses timed to the patient's heartbeat.
